causal-factors.name: Recent blockbuster 100M+ modern art sale (Klimt, 2025)
causal-factors.rationale: Klimt's Portrait of Elisabeth Lederer sold for $236.4 million at Sotheby’s in New York in November 2025, setting a modern-art auction record and signaling a high price ceiling for public paintings at major houses within the window.

causal-factors.name: Historical base-rate of 100M+ public painting sales at Christie’s/Sotheby’s
causal-factors.rationale: Public records show multiple 100M+ paintings at Christie’s/Sotheby’s over the past decade (e.g., Picasso 106.5m in 2010; Picasso 179.4m in 2015; Monet 110.7m in 2019; Warhol 195m in 2022; Klimt 236.4m in 2025), indicating a persistent capability to reach and exceed $100 million in a single public sale.

causal-factors.name: Phillips’ absence of 100M+ public painting sales to date
causal-factors.rationale: Phillips has not delivered a publicly reported painting sale at or above $100 million (e.g., 2024/2025 evenings and days totals are well below that threshold), which dampens the likelihood that the next 100M+ public painting sale occurs at Phillips.

causal-factors.name: Escalating top-end painting sale records at Christie’s and Sotheby’s
causal-factors.rationale: Recent public paintings reaching or exceeding $100m at Christie’s and Sotheby’s (e.g., Picasso 106.5m in 2010; Monet 110.7m in 2019; Picasso Les Femmes d'Alger Version O 179.365m in 2015; Warhol Marilyn 195m in 2022; Gustav Klimt Portrait of Elisabeth Lederer 236.4m in 2025; Salvator Mundi 450.3m in 2017) demonstrate sustained capacity for a $100m+ public painting sale. ([washingtonpost.com](https://www.washingtonpost.com/archive/style/2010/05/05/picasso-painting-sells-for-record-1065m/855e3b6c-27e3-45cd-b555-10f535fddd2f/?utm_source=openai))

causal-factors.name: Global bidder participation and competition in top-end sales
causal-factors.rationale: Klimt’s 2025 sale drew six bidders, and historic top-end sales have featured broad international participation and bidding wars, indicating robust demand that could push a future sale over $100m. ([theguardian.com](https://www.theguardian.com/artanddesign/2025/nov/19/gustav-klimt-portrait-sells-for-2364m-making-it-the-second-most-expensive-artwork-sold-at-auction))

causal-factors.name: Phillips remains weaker than Christie’s/Sotheby’s at hitting $100m+ for paintings
causal-factors.rationale: Phillips’ public painting results have not reached $100m (e.g., 2024 Day Sale around $25m, 2024 Evening around $54m, 2025 Day Sale around $21.5m), suggesting Phillips is less likely to report a $100m+ painting before May 1, 2026. ([phillips.com](https://www.phillips.com/press/release/phillips-new-york-evening-sale-of-modern-contemporary-art-realizes-54-million-led-by-postwar-and-contemporary-masters?utm_source=openai))

causal-factors.name: Art-market cooling and macroeconomic uncertainty
causal-factors.rationale: Art-market volumes and top-end sales have shown signs of cooling in 2023–2025, with macro headwinds and slower global growth weighing on liquidity and willingness to pay record prices. ([cnbc.com](https://www.cnbc.com/2025/07/25/fine-art-auction-sales.html?utm_source=openai))

causal-factors.name: Recent record-breaking modern-art sale (Klimt, Portrait of Elisabeth Lederer, $236.4M at Sotheby's, Nov 2025)
causal-factors.rationale: A public auction at a major house fetched well above $100M in 2025, indicating strong bidder demand for top-tier paintings.

causal-factors.name: Historical frequency of $100M+ paintings at Christie’s/Sotheby’s (e.g., Salvator Mundi, Picasso, Warhol, Monet)
causal-factors.rationale: Past record of multiple $100M+ public sales shows a non-negligible base-rate that supports higher odds of another occurrence.

causal-factors.name: Phillips’ lack of $100M+ public painting sales to date
causal-factors.rationale: Phillips has not publicly achieved a $100M+ painting sale, which exerts downward pressure relative to anchor scenarios centered on Christie’s/Sotheby’s.

causal-factors.name: Auction-window timing through May 1, 2026
causal-factors.rationale: With the ongoing 2025–2026 season, more opportunities exist for a $100M+ public painting sale within the horizon.

synthesis: The objections reveal plausible dampening factors (market cooling, Phillips track record, and timing), justifying a modest downward calibration from the 87% ensemble. Historical 100M+ sales at Christie’s/Sotheby’s keep the event plausible within the window, but the horizon and Phillips-specific risks temper the odds.
